learned_rules:
- **MIGRATED: buy the pullback, 10–60% off the local high** (owner). It has to hold above the hourly low, with 5m ≥ $10k and more buys than sells (V1, V6). Within 10% of the high it's a PASS with the blocker "chasing" (near-high skips: 8 ran / 25 dumped; CATCULUS −59%, SI −38%). Every PASS names its blocker.
- **Press the proven setup: rate it 8–9.** That means the meta or vamp-field flow leader, 25–45% off the high, a higher-low base above the hourly low, clean holders (top 10 <15%, bundles verified low) and 5m at or above the hourly pace. That's an 8. A strong live meta with a real crowd makes it a 9. Both wins were this trade (CATBOT +94%, FLOATER +51%, both 34–38% off). Any setup that passes the hard lines with live flow and a clear target is at least a 7 (owner).
- **Shallow band (10–20% off the high): flow leader only, and conviction caps at 7.** 5m must be at or above the hourly pace, otherwise PASS with the blocker "flow below pace". Near-high entries are 0 for 5 in my book (HYPERCHAN ×2, PILLSEY, SI, CATCULUS).
- **A spike counts as chasing anywhere in the band.** If the last 5m candle is up more than 25%, or a green spike runs above 3x the hourly pace, wait for it to retrace and print a higher low (PILLSEY −31%, V1).
- **Name a target at least 1.5x from entry before buying.** That's the prior high, the POC, a 0.618 extension or a clean breakout. If the only visible level is under 1.5x, PASS with the blocker "target below initials" (SWAN topped at its own 1.4x level).
- **Fresh migration (<1h) going red off the bond spike:** wait for a base above the hourly low (too-new skips: 7 ran / 43 dumped, V1).
- **Vamp field:** buy only the leader by 5m volume and attention, never a copy (V1, V2; FLOATER beat 22 copies; vamp skips: 1 ran / 6 dumped).
- **DIP needs a visible higher low.** That means a bounce off the hourly low, a pullback that holds above it, and price now above that pullback low. The stop goes under the higher low; if that's more than 20% below entry, PASS. Never buy the first red-to-green candle (HEXN #1; no-higher-low skips: 0 ran / 14 dumped).
- **DIP attention gate:** 5m at least 0.7x the hourly average (owner; it doesn't need to be rising), plus a live story with a real crowd. Weak or LARP tech dips are a PASS (HEXN lost twice). Size DIPs by conviction.
- **Hack stories: PASS.** That covers hacked projects, exploit or drain headlines, and Hack-Inu copies (owner rule).
- **Hard blocks stay:** top 10 >25%, dev >1%, bundles/insiders over the line, mint/freeze live, LP not burned, political figure (V6, V13, V17). Their skips: top 10 7 ran / 33 dumped, dev 0 / 12, bundles 0 / 5, political 0 / 3, RugCheck danger 5 / 13.
- **Protect green trades before initials.** If 5m volume falls under half its hourly pace, sell half (CPU and FLOAT peaked ~1.6x and closed red). If a stop review fires on a trade that already hit ~1.3x, sell all of it and never trim (PILLSEY).
- **Time stop at 45 min:** exit if under 1.0x with no volume surge (V1). One exception: a coin above $1M that's green on mcap, holding its range low, with 5m at or above the hourly pace gets a single extension to 90 min (HYPERCHAN #2). No other extensions (FLOAT held to 158 min and lost).
- **Stop review defaults to SELL.** Always sell if the trade never went green, or if the top-10 or insider share dropped while price bleeds (SI, HEXN, CATCULUS gapped to −36% to −59%). Hold once only when the bundle exit is visible and both the story and 5m volume are clearly intact.
- **Re-enter a stopped coin only when it reclaims its prior high,** never mid-range on a base (CATBOT buy-back −24%).
